paper_metadata.title: Effect of combined addition of Ni and Sc on microstructure and high-temperature mechanical properties of an Al-Cu-Mn alloy

evidence.quote: The effects of Ni and Sc modifications on the microstructure and mechanical properties of Al-Cu-Mn alloys at room and high temperatures were systematically studied.

Pure aluminum (purity ≥ 99.97 %) was preheated in a resistance furnace at 740 ◦C and melted. Then, Al-50Cu, Al-5Zr, Al-5V, Al-10Ni, Al-5Ti, Al-10Sc, Al-5Ti-B alloys, and pure Cd were added sequentially and stirred thoroughly. C6Cl6 refining agent was added for refining. The melt temperature was then reduced to 720 ◦C and cast into a preheated (200 ◦C) cast iron mold to produce three alloys with different compositions: base alloy, 1# alloy, and 2# alloy.
The prepared alloys underwent T6 heat treatment: 538 ◦C for 8 h (solid solution treatment), rapid water quenching, and aging at 175 ◦C for 12 h.
